eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Santa Fe, NM; at 4:12 PM on AUG 10, 2026 Effective until 12:12 AM AUG 11, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
AlertSantaFe: Emergency Message

Due to increased activity on the Frijoles Fire, the individuals on Camino de Canon in Cundiyo are placed in GO status. Residents should Evacuate immediately. Evacuation site is the Pojoaque valley middle school gym at 1797 State Road 502. Crews are standing by
